name: The Skybreaker Bulwark

angles.text: As a warrior, you can learn the Skybreaker Defense technique by recovering the ancestral shield.
As a paladin, you may value the work of reclaiming a blessed heirloom from a corrupt cultist.

faq.answer: The Skybreakers are an ancient lineage on Zephras Isle, nearly wiped out by the Al'Aketh. The one who asks for the shield is the sole survivor.
The Skybreaker Bulwark is an ancestral shield of the Skybreaker line on Zephras Isle. Family tradition says no harm can befall anyone worthy to wield it.
The Al'Aketh slew the Skybreaker family on Zephras Isle, leaving one survivor to mourn their loss.
Zaal Stormshield is a cultist who took the Skybreaker Bulwark after the Skybreaker family was slain. He lurks with the heirloom at the Shrine of Akir on Zephras Isle.
The Shrine of Akir is on Zephras Isle. Zaal Stormshield lurks there with the stolen Skybreaker Bulwark.
faq.q: Where is the Shrine of Akir?

faq.answer: The last Skybreaker seeks the Bulwark's return to right the family's shame and take the sacred relic from unworthy hands. In return, the survivor teaches the Skybreaker Defense technique.
faq.q: Why must the Bulwark be reclaimed?

sections.body: On Zephras Isle, the Al'Aketh have slain the Skybreakers, leaving one survivor. The last of the family bears deep sorrow and bitter shame over the loss of their greatest heirloom. The cultist Zaal Stormshield took the Skybreaker Bulwark and now lurks at the Shrine of Akir.
sections.title: A Fallen Lineage

sections.body: By family tradition, the Skybreaker Bulwark protects anyone truly worthy to wield it. The last Skybreaker believes Zaal unworthy of its divine favor. So the survivor seeks an adventurer to strike down the thief at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim the ancestral shield. In return, the Skybreaker offers training in the Skybreaker Defense technique.
sections.title: The Sacred Shield

summary: At the Shrine of Akir, Zaal Stormshield holds the Skybreaker Bulwark. The last of the Skybreakers seeks its return from the cultist who took it.
